outgoingFlows.description: Infection via contact with infectious individuals.
Quarantine of exposed cases before they become infectious.
Progression from latent infection to presymptomatic infectiousness.
Progression to symptomatic mild-to-moderate infectious disease.
Testing and isolation of nonsevere symptomatic cases.
Recovery from mild-to-moderate infection without isolation.
Progression from quarantined exposed state to presymptomatic infectiousness while isolated.
Progression to symptomatic mild-to-moderate infectious disease while isolated.
Hospital admission for severe isolated cases.
Progression from hospital to ICU for severe cases requiring intensive care.
Recovery for hospitalized cases not requiring ICU care.
Recovery after ICU and post-ICU hospitalization.
Transfer from ICU to post-ICU hospital care for survivors.

uncertainty_analysis.methodologyNotes: This task is **parameter uncertainty quantification**: documenting uncertainty about **numerical parameter values** in the .compmodel (not structural or stochastic uncertainty). Confidence is **mostly Unknown** unless a small built-in heuristic matches the disease name (COVID-19, Malaria, HIV) and parameter name substrings — assigning High/Medium/Low requires curated literature ranges or expert review; see Phase 1 README (Validity & limitations).
